description: A feature-rich 3D Coin Pusher arcade game engine featuring procedural effect generation, dynamic wall systems, and a built-in slot machine mini-game.

scenes.description: The primary gameplay scene containing the pusher table and core logic.

scripts.responsibility: Core game loop, scoring, and state management.
Handles the slot machine mini-game logic, procedural UI, and rewards.
Coin physics, collision handling, and type-specific attributes.

humanSetupInstructions: Ensure TextMeshPro is imported in the project (Window > TextMeshPro > Import TMP Essentials).
Assign the 'Player', 'Coin', and 'ScoreZone' tags to the corresponding GameObjects in the scene.
The project utilizes procedural generation for UI and VFX, so specific prefabs are not strictly required for basic functionality.
Ensure an AudioListener is present in the scene for sound effects.
Verify that the Main Camera has a Rigidbody if you intend to use custom physics scripts that interact with it.
